description: This file defines the OutpostsBucketArn class which models and parses S3 Outposts bucket ARNs, including validation logic for ARN components.

classes.name: OutpostsBucketArn
classes.description: Represents an S3 Outposts bucket ARN with parsing and validation capabilities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into components identifying an OutpostsBucketArn object.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the bucket name component of the ARN.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Returns the Outpost ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: parseOutpostData
methods.description: Extracts Outpost ID, bucket label, and bucket name from resource ID string.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the components of the ARN for correctness and completeness.
